svg.desc: End to end on real coding-agent traces, 4 agents, MTP depth 3, Tesla V100 32 GB cards, 2026-10-21 to 2026-10-22: best 47.23 generated tok/s (run best24, package model-32k-tonight-a, pre-release binary 2f9128e4), median 43.4 over 23 runs. The release binary d4ffb1fa was not measured on real traces. Source: BENCHMARKS-SM70.md, STATUS.md line 68.
